_meta.purpose: Source of truth for MCP criticality. When an MCP errors during a session, check here to decide: restart the bridge, wait it out, or work around.

tiers.critical: workflow fails or the agent will fabricate without it — escalate to user for restart
tiers.important: degraded but workable via fallback — note and continue
tiers.optional: nice-to-have — safe to ignore for the session

_meta.fallback_rule: Only claim an MCP is broken after attempting to use it and getting an error. Report the actual error, not a guess.

qmd.purpose: semantic memory search over daily logs, MEMORY.md, feedback/
qmd.fallback: Grep across the workspace — slower, no semantic matching

google-calendar.fallback: ask the user for what's on their calendar, do not guess

email.fallback: the user's web mail UI via browser

_template_entry.purpose: one sentence on what this MCP does for you
_template_entry.fallback: what to do when it's down — or 'none' if no fallback exists
